# 2026-09-12

Landed 07:20, wrecked. Train and tram to the hotel took 40 minutes. The Example
Hotel first gave us 304 on the 3rd floor, facing the car park; the front desk
(Ruben) moved us to **room 707 on the 7th floor**, a corner king with a big
window over the park. Gold status paid off. Napped, walked the park, Negronis
at the FakeLounge rooftop bar at sunset.
